content.title: Michael Lock, Author at Aberdeen Strategy & Research
content.text: As Senior Vice President and Principal Analyst, Michael is responsible for managing the strategic direction of Aberdeen’s research coverage into both traditional and cutting-edge topic areas, including analytics, business intelligence, internet of things (IoT), and artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning, while maintaining oversight of 16 different research practice areas. He holds a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from Trinity College and an MBA from Babson College. 3 Reasons to Take an Embedded Approach to Analytics In this video, Mike Lock discusses the research theme that the team has been exploring in the Analytics space in Spending to Save: The Cost Conundrum for Small Retailers As the holidays wrap up and NRF — the largest retail event of the year — kicks off this week, Transformative Data Intelligence: Strengthening Business Reporting to Drive Performance In the wake of COVID-19, companies have had to find creative ways to accelerate their digital transformation efforts. Those that have fortified their data environment and improved business reporting have seen improvements in their workforce performance and key business metrics. Learn more. Unified Integration in Action: How to Enhance Data Flow and Fortify Governance A comprehensive data integration strategy complete with strong governance and oversight is more important than ever. Here's three ways you can improve your data and governance. Struggling, Surviving, or Thriving? Where are we, Really? April 2020 showed the highest number of single-month job cuts in the U.S. since comparable records were first tracked over 27 years ago. On the other hand, certain markets (and a wee-bit of government stimulus) have helped keep the economy afloat. So…where are we, really? Elevating Analytics with Cloud-Based Data As the technology landscape evolves, a cloud-based approach becomes more and more necessary for companies to maintain their competitive position. Best-in-Class companies that leverage a cloud-based data architecture are more organizationally mature, technically savvy, and reap the benefit of superior business performance as a result. Augmented Analytics: The Cyborg Brain Continues to Develop Companies today are more likely to view augmented analytics as “mission critical” to business processes than ever before, and the performance benefits will only continue to drive internal and external efficiency. Intent Data in the Healthcare Sector: What are the Hottest Technologies? Aberdeen's intent data reveals how specific organizations in the healthcare sector are consuming content, and where they might be making near-term investments. How Intent Data Reveals the Anatomy of an AI Buyer Aberdeen's intent data reveals what AI buyers are researching on the web. But content consumed doesn’t necessarily equal content desired. Is this what AI buyers want to read, or is this simply what’s available? To Build or Buy with Embedded BI Software vendors prefer to buy a third party’s analytics capabilities, and general enterprises prefer to build their own. But are these the wisest choices? How Modern is Your Data Environment, Really? Companies typically fall into one of three levels of maturity when it comes to their data infrastructure: Primitive, standard, and high-performance. Which one are you? Tableau’s Push Toward Analytical Ubiquity and the Three Ways to Get There Aberdeen SVP and Principal Analyst, Mike Lock shares his insights and takeaways from Tableau's 2018 Conference in New Orleans, focusing on the future potential of ubiquitous analytics in peoples' daily business lives. Big Data Analytics in Manufacturing: Are Top Companies as Active as They Could Be? Aberdeen’s expanded coverage of the BI / Analytics sector tracks companies actively researching topics related to decision support and analysis. How many Fortune 1000 manufacturers are "in-market" right now, and what's holding the rest back? Are You a Citizen Data Scientist? Am I? People want to do cool things with their data, and most of them aren’t PhDs in statistical analysis. Enter the “citizen data scientist." Finding the Analytics Sweet Spot to Optimize Business Decisions Companies, industries, and even entire markets can turn on a dime, and that leaves decision makers scrambling to make the most accurate, timely business decisions they can. The challenge isn’t only making the best business decisions, but knowing how to extract meaningful insight from company data to make those decisions. Styx and Stacks and Other Tracks from Domopalooza 2018 Aberdeen Vice President and Principal Analyst Mike Lock reviews this year's Domopalooza 2018 in Salt Lake City, and gives his two cents on the two areas Domo emphasized the most: AI / Machine learning and full-stack platforms. How AI is Already Being Used in the Business World Despite its relative nascence as an enterprise technology, the application of AI in a business setting is seemingly limitless. #DataStrong at Mandalay Bay for Tableau Conference 2017 Principal Analyst Mike Lock had these takeaways from Tableau Conference 2017. Among other things, he saw Tableau going strong on enterprise readiness and data prep. Data Rehabilitation: The Driving Force Behind Healthcare Technology Healthcare providers that embrace the right technologies will be rewarded with deeper, more comprehensive insights and immediate opportunities to reduce cost and achieve better outcomes for their business and their patients. The Search for Business Intelligence: What Tools Are Needed? How can your company be "data driven" if not technical users only have limited access to data? Data-Driven Finance and the Analytical Edge Few internal departments can claim a greater need for analytics and data-driven insights than finance. Tableau Conference 2016: The $800M Gorilla on the Loose Aberdeen's Mike Lock attended Tableau's recent conference in Austin. Here are his big takeaways. Is Your Finance Team Getting Data Fast Enough? The finance department has long been rich in data, but CFOs often receive data too late to inform strategic decisions. Unleashing the Power of Analytics in the Cloud Using a cloud-only or hybrid analytical environment carries strong potential benefits that can be brought out in a variety of different ways. Three Reasons Why Your Users Should Care about IoT data According to recent research exploring companies that use Internet of Things (IoT) data frequently, quicker and richer decisions are being made by leveraging this data. Alteryx Inspire 2016: Is There a Cure for Data Hate? When analyst Mike Lock attended Inspire 2016, he came away with one big question: Why do people hate their data? Three Key Criteria When Selecting Data Visualization Tools Recent Aberdeen research explored the impact of data visualization and found that, in addition to greater analytical engagement, business users shared three common characteristics of satisfaction. Three Critical Steps to Enhanced Data Quality In order to get to a higher level of data quality, and thus, usable insight, organizations should focus on these three key activities. All Data is Not Created Equal: The User Impact of Data Prep All data is not created equal. Therefore, these three effective data preparation activities can have a substantial positive impact on business users in your organization. For the Mid-Market, Executives Lead the Analytical Charge In the mid-market, senior leadership isn't just consuming analytical findings -- those involved in its creation are reaping the benefits of more relevant, trustworthy, and actionable insight.
